newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Arbed says U.S. unit to be bought by former chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Arbed says U.S. unit to be bought by former chiefs.

text.p: Luxembourg steel maker Arbed said on Monday that Circuit Foil USA, which it and Japan's Furukawa Electric Co bought in 1990, was to be acquired by two former members of Circuit Foil's management.
It gave no financial details of the deal.

"Charles B. Yates and Craig W. Yates announced...they have entered into an agreement with Arbed and Furukawa Electric Co for the private purchase of Circuit Foil USA of Bordentown, New Jersey," Arbed said in a statement.
The Yates brothers were president and chairman respectively of the company, then called Yates Industries Inc, before it was sold in 1980 to Square D Co.
Arbed and Furukawa bought the business from Square D, along with the overseas foil manufacturing plants of Yates Industries.
Arbed and Furukawa would continue to own copper foil production facilities in Asia and Europe through Circuit Foil Japan Ltd and Circuit Foil Luxembourg SA, the statement said.
Also, Circuit Foil would continue to have technology exchange and sales arrangements with its Luxembourg and Japanese counterparts.

Charles and Craig Yates are currently respectively chairman and president of Financial Corporation and Farmers and Mechanics Bank, a New Jersey community bank with 17 branches, Arbed's statement said.
